summary.method: WGS84 point-in-polygon, holes supported. Official Geo API Paris commune 75056 contour includes both woods. Points within 100m of the boundary are held for address or finer-boundary review; distance is approximate local equirectangular. For ways this tests supplied representative point, not the entire footprint.
limits: Boundary membership validates location only, not present business operation or bar eligibility.
Coordinate errors, polygon generalization, and sites straddling borders require review; 100m band is conservative triage, not a claim of stated source precision.
